services.description: Certifies caste/community (SC/ST/OBC/MBC) for education, jobs, reservations.
services.where_to_apply: Nearest eSevai / CSC centre across Tamil Nadu, or online at https://www.tnesevai.tn.gov.in
application_steps: Visit nearest eSevai centre with all required documents.
Tell the operator you need 'Community Certificate' (Service ID: REV-101).
Operator fills the application form on your behalf.
Pay the service charge (Rs. 60).
Collect acknowledgement receipt with reference number.
Certificate/output will be ready within 7 working days.
Collect or download from eSevai centre / citizen portal.

qa_pairs.question: What is Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: Community Certificate (Service ID: REV-101) is a service offered through Tamil Nadu eSevai centres by the Revenue. Certifies caste/community (SC/ST/OBC/MBC) for education, jobs, reservations.

qa_pairs.question: What documents are required for Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: The following documents are required for Community Certificate: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, School TC / SSLC Certificate, Father's Community Certificate, Nativity Certificate, Passport photo (2).

qa_pairs.question: What is the fee for Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: The service charge for Community Certificate is Rs. 60.

qa_pairs.question: How long does Community Certificate take?
qa_pairs.answer: Community Certificate is processed within 7 working days from the date of application at the eSevai centre.

qa_pairs.question: What is the validity of Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: Community Certificate is valid for: Lifetime.

qa_pairs.question: Who can apply for Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: Any eligible citizen can apply for Community Certificate at the nearest eSevai / CSC centre in Tamil Nadu. Certifies caste/community (SC/ST/OBC/MBC) for education, jobs, reservations.

qa_pairs.question: How do I apply for Community Certificate step by step?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Visit the nearest eSevai centre with all required documents. 2. Inform the operator you need 'Community Certificate'. 3. Operator fills the application form on your behalf. 4. Pay the service charge of Rs. 60. 5. Collect acknowledgement receipt with reference number. 6. Processing time: 7 working days. 7. Output: Certificate issued by Tahsildar.

qa_pairs.question: What is the output or certificate issued for Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: After processing, you will receive: Certificate issued by Tahsildar.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I download the user manual for Community Certificate?
qa_pairs.answer: You can download the official user manual for Community Certificate from this link: https://www.tnesevai.tn.gov.in/Pages/PPT/UserManual_eSevai_for_all_Registration.pdf — open it in your browser (Chrome/Edge) and it will download as a PDF.

qa_pairs.answer: Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration is a free service with no charge.

qa_pairs.question: How long does Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration take?
qa_pairs.answer: Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration is processed within Instant from the date of application at the eSevai centre.

qa_pairs.question: What is the validity of Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration?
qa_pairs.answer: Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration is valid for: Permanent.

qa_pairs.question: Who can apply for Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration?
qa_pairs.answer: Any eligible citizen can apply for Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration at the nearest eSevai / CSC centre in Tamil Nadu. Create CAN (Citizen Account Number) — unique TNeGA profile for all eSevai services and history.

qa_pairs.question: How do I apply for Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration step by step?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Visit the nearest eSevai centre with all required documents. 2. Inform the operator you need 'Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration'. 3. Operator fills the application form on your behalf. 4. This service is free — no charge. 5. Collect acknowledgement receipt with reference number. 6. Processing time: Instant. 7. Output: CAN Number and TNeGA citizen portal login.

qa_pairs.question: What is the output or certificate issued for Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration?
qa_pairs.answer: After processing, you will receive: CAN Number and TNeGA citizen portal login.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I download the user manual for Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration?
qa_pairs.answer: You can download the official user manual for Citizen Account Number (CAN) Registration from this link: https://www.tnesevai.tn.gov.in/Pages/PPT/UserManual_eSevai_for_all_Registration.pdf — open it in your browser (Chrome/Edge) and it will download as a PDF.
